workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The accepted written work is a dependent sequence of sections that need continuity and checkpoint support across drafting sessions.
reroute_triggers: Artist reduces the work to one compact artifact, or the project expands into full long-form canon.

story_structure.name: Problem / Reframe / Return
story_structure.core_movement: A threshold problem is named, reframed through the cost of return, then left as residue.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The text sequence moves from key, to lit room, to refusal, with each section depending on the prior emotional claim.
story_structure.turn_logic: The apparent route home becomes a pressure system that cannot be solved by opening the door.
story_structure.compression_rule: Keep each section tied to one threshold object or action.
story_structure.expansion_rule: Expand only by adding sections that change the emotional claim and preserve continuity.
failure_modes: the door opens and resolves the pressure
the ending explains the emotion instead of preserving residue

beats.one_move_summary: The key appears as agency that cannot yet be used.
beats.before_state: The threshold has not yet become a choice.
beats.after_state: The object of entry makes the choice feel close and painful.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A key should make entry possible.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The key proves that entry is available but emotionally blocked.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: Turns agency into tension before the sequence expands.

beats.intended_feeling: the ache of almost having agency
beats.emotional_payload: The opening section establishes a usable object that cannot solve the feeling.

tension_profile.name: Agency / Paralysis
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the key emotionally active instead of merely symbolic

source_evidence: The reference centers a key at a threshold.
must_preserve: the key should not become an easy solution

pivot_options.label: lit-room
pivot_options.next_move: Move from the key to the lit room that should welcome return.
pivot_options.rationale: The sequence needs the second section to test whether entry is actually safe.

medium_translation_notes.text: Open with tactile pressure around the key and withhold explanation.

traceability_notes.note: The artist meaning requires agency without resolution.

beats.one_move_summary: The lit room becomes a dangerous welcome rather than safety.
beats.before_state: The key has made return possible.
beats.after_state: The possible return feels tender and unsafe.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A lit room should make return easier.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The light increases the cost of crossing.

beats.emotional_payload: The middle section deepens continuity by making the previous key more costly.

tension_profile.name: Safety / Risk
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the sequence from treating return as simple

source_evidence: The reference holds a lit room beyond the threshold.
must_preserve: the light must remain tender and dangerous

pivot_options.label: withheld-crossing
pivot_options.next_move: Stop before entry and let the refusal carry residue.
pivot_options.rationale: The final section must preserve the unresolved threshold.

medium_translation_notes.text: Let the second section depend on the key established in the first section.

traceability_notes.note: The lit room changes what the key means.

beats.one_move_summary: The sequence stops before entry and preserves unresolved return.
beats.before_state: The lit room has made crossing emotionally costly.
beats.after_state: The threshold remains active because the crossing is withheld.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The final section should decide whether the speaker enters.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The text ends with the choice still held in the body.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: Protects the intended feeling from resolution.

beats.emotional_payload: The final section turns the dependent sequence into residue rather than closure.
source_evidence: The reference refuses to complete the threshold crossing.
must_preserve: do not invent an aftermath or resolution

pivot_options.label: stop
pivot_options.rationale: The work succeeds by preserving the pressure.

medium_translation_notes.text: End shorter than the prior sections and preserve active absence.

traceability_notes.note: The residue depends on the lit room's danger.

tension_points.summary: The key and lit room make return possible while the body refuses resolution.
tension_points.emotional_payload: Agency, welcome, and refusal remain active together.

traceability_notes.note: The tension point preserves the artist's unresolved threshold.
The key is the opening pressure source.
The room changes the meaning of entry.
The ending depends on the prior risk.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Each section must change the threshold pressure rather than repeat it.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: Artist may waive only if the cumulative sequence is intentionally flattened.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block expansion if adjacent sections repeat the same threshold claim.

arc_summary.turn: The lit room makes return tender and unsafe.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: The sections are dependent cumulative parts, not one interchangeable compact artifact.

traceability_summary.note: The cumulative text plan preserves unresolved return as the governing meaning.
